name: Eroded Horn
description:
The Lord of Eroded Primal Fire's blazing horn, cut off in the heat of battle.
Legend has it that the original primal flame was the birthplace of light and wisdom, and the horn of the Pyro Dragon shone like a pillar of fire, illuminating the savage, desolate world.
And though the base of the flaming horn has been corroded, the light that once illuminated the world remains without blemish.
fullDescription: The Lord of Eroded Primal Fire's blazing horn, cut off in the heat of battle.\nLegend has it that the first Pyro Dragons clashed with their horns, passing on their wisdom like a flaming torch to ancient dragonkind. This was a blessing bestowed by the primordial master of elements through fire and blood. Though the bloodline of the Dragonheirs is now so thin as to be all but lost, this ancient blessing is still passed on to this day.\nAnd though the base of the flaming horn has been corroded, the light that once illuminated the world remains without blemish.
sources: Lv. 70+ Lord of Eroded Primal Fire Challenge Reward
